messages.text:
You could serve to wifi by default. let's investigate and fix the rules

leader run `node tools/console.mjs proposal phone PR-018` and update the link into proposal

**Done: PR-018 and PR-019 are on the Wi-Fi now.** Their phone links show on the Proposals page within 30 seconds.

| proposal | phone pages |
|---|---|
| PR-018 (end-of-page menu) | A http://lan:6142/, B http://lan:6143/ |
| PR-019 "exact" (accent word) | A http://lan:6144/, B http://lan:6145/ |
| PR-019 "slide" | A http://lan:6144/, B http://lan:6146/ |
| PR-019 "keep" | no page needed: it is today's page |

**Wi-Fi by default:** agreed. A tools helper will change it so every new proposal and every revision starts its phone pages by itself. Until then, I start them for each new proposal myself.

What you need to do: nothing; open the phone links when you want to try them.

Fixed and on main: a new proposal now starts its phone Try-it pages by itself, so "not on the Wi-Fi now" should not appear any more.

- Before, the lead had to run one extra command for every open proposal.
- Now posting or revising a proposal serves A and B on the Wi-Fi at once (incident I-143).

What you need to do: open the next new proposal on the iPhone and tell me if A and B load.
